spec.rawSql:

FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE

    AND COALESCE(rooms_group, '') ~ '${rooms:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(renovation, '') ~ '${renovation:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(floor_category, '') ~ '${floor_category:regex}'
    AND (

spec.title: Listings by District — Top 10
spec.description: Количество объявлений в десяти районах с наибольшим числом записей.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    district,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE
    district IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(rooms_group, '') ~ '${rooms:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(renovation, '') ~ '${renovation:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(floor_category, '') ~ '${floor_category:regex}'
    AND (
        COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
    )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY listings DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Median Price per m² by District — Top 10
spec.description: Районы с наибольшей медианной стоимостью квадратного метра.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    district,
    ROUND(
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_sqm)
    ) AS median_price_per_sqm
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE
    price_per_sqm > 0
    AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(rooms_group, '') ~ '${rooms:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(renovation, '') ~ '${renovation:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(floor_category, '') ~ '${floor_category:regex}'
    AND (
        COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
    )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY median_price_per_sqm DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    price_range,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN price_rub < 5000000 THEN 'До 5 млн ₽'
            WHEN price_rub < 10000000 THEN '5–10 млн ₽'
            WHEN price_rub < 15000000 THEN '10–15 млн ₽'
            WHEN price_rub < 25000000 THEN '15–25 млн ₽'
            ELSE 'От 25 млн ₽'
        END AS price_range,
        CASE
            WHEN price_rub < 5000000 THEN 1
            WHEN price_rub < 10000000 THEN 2
            WHEN price_rub < 15000000 THEN 3
            WHEN price_rub < 25000000 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END AS sort_order
    FROM public.apartments_analysis
    WHERE price_rub > 0
        AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
        AND COALESCE(rooms_group, '') ~ '${rooms:regex}'
        AND COALESCE(renovation, '') ~ '${renovation:regex}'
        AND COALESCE(floor_category, '') ~ '${floor_category:regex}'
        AND (
            COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
            OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
            OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        )
) p
GROUP BY price_range, sort_order
ORDER BY sort_order;

spec.title: District Summary
spec.description: Сводная таблица по районам: количество объявлений, медианная цена и медианная цена за м².

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    district,
    COUNT(*) AS listings,
    ROUND(
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_rub)
    ) AS median_price_rub,
    ROUND(
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_sqm)
    ) AS median_price_per_sqm
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE
    district IS NOT NULL
    AND price_rub > 0
    AND price_per_sqm > 0
    AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(rooms_group, '') ~ '${rooms:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(renovation, '') ~ '${renovation:regex}'
    AND COALESCE(floor_category, '') ~ '${floor_category:regex}'
    AND (
        COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
        OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
    )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY listings DESC;
